items.title: 11.7 Alkenes ki banawat aur reactivity (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.7 heading, printed page 256.

blocks.text: Alkenes ki reactivity carbon-carbon double bond ki banawat se nikalti hai. Yeh hissa ethene ki banawat (11.7.1), pi bond ki reactivity, carbocation ki stability aur alkyl groups ka inductive effect (11.7.2) aur electron kheenchne wala inductive effect (11.7.3) bayan karta hai. Alkenes alkanes se zyada reactive hain, aur un ke reactions zyada tar carbocations se guzarte hain.

blocks.prompt: Stability mein alkane alkene se kaise mukhtalif hai (Quick Check 11.5a)?
blocks.explanation: Alkane mein sirf mazboot sigma bonds hain aur woh zyada tar reagents ki taraf mustahkam hai; alkene mein is ke ilawa pi bond hai jis ke electrons bond ke mehwar ke oopar neeche hain, dheele pakre hue aur electrophiles ke hamle ke liye aasan, to alkene kam mustahkam aur kahin zyada reactive hai.

items: Alkene ki reactivity C=C ki banawat se aati hai: kamzor, khula pi bond aur carbocations se reactions (11.7.1 se 11.7.3).
